rule: a per-class cell prints its value only if the reference support in that population is >= s units; otherwise n<s with the support; a statistic whose own denominator is empty prints undefined; suppression changes no aggregate and no macro membership

support_units.agreement_tables: unweighted reference rows in the population: (paragraph x technology) units for technologies and elements; frame-bearing reference units for evaluation values (score B); matched units for score A
support_units.displacement_table: distinct paragraphs of the population on which the reference carries the class
support_units.reliability_table: aligned units on which the first coding is positive (technology ticks, element flags); units inside the applicability mask for evaluation and comparison target
